answer: Seed a few trusted agents and let trust spread by short random walks over the co-signature graph, so each account earns the share of walks that land on it. A farm of k clones can co-sign itself densely, yet walks leak in only through attack edges, the few honest agents it persuades, so its total trust stays flat while k grows and each clone's share falls like 1/k. Every extra honest endorsement costs real persuasion, as scarce as an oasis in the desert. A comet of fresh accounts burns out, and a nebula of clones stays dim.
